label.name: Name
label.noAttendance: No attendance. Leave says a date is authorized; what happened on it is Attendance's record.
label.noDocuments: No documents. An attachment is a reference, and nothing here verifies it resolves.
label.noEmploymentStatus: No employment status. An employee on leave is employed; there is no on_leave state anywhere.
label.noMoney: No money. Not a rate, not a multiplier, not an amount — what a leave day costs is Payroll's.
label.noStatutory: No statutory content. Every leave type, figure and rule is configuration a tenant or a country pack supplies.
label.readOnly: Read-only. Every change goes through the API; the write screens belong to a later phase.
label.unavailable: The leave register is not available to this session yet.

rejection.accrual_band_did_not_match: No service band in this policy covers this employment, so nothing was accrued for them.
rejection.accrual_method_unknown: That is not a way of accruing leave this product understands.
rejection.adjustment_requires_a_reason: An adjustment to somebody's balance needs a reason code.
rejection.already_decided: This request has already been decided, so it cannot be taken back.
rejection.already_decided_by_this_approver: You have already decided this request.
rejection.approvals_required_out_of_range: That is not a sensible number of approvals.
rejection.assignment_overlaps: Another policy already governs that scope over those dates.
rejection.attachment_required: Leave of this length needs supporting evidence attached.
rejection.backdated_beyond_policy: This request is back-dated {days} days, and the policy permits {permitted}.
rejection.blackout_period: Leave cannot be taken during that period.
rejection.carry_over_cap_missing: A carry-over capped by {method} needs a cap to be set.
rejection.carry_over_has_not_expired_yet: Carried-over leave does not expire until later.
rejection.carry_over_method_unknown: That is not a way of carrying leave over this product understands.
rejection.code_malformed: "{field}" is not a valid code. Use lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
rejection.date_malformed: {field} is not a date. Use the form YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.day_portion_unknown: That is not a portion of a day this product understands.
rejection.duration_basis_unknown: That is not a way of counting leave this product understands.
rejection.eligibility_rule_not_satisfied: This employment does not meet the eligibility rule for this leave.
rejection.employment_not_found: No such employment on that date.
rejection.entitlement_source_unknown: That is not a source of entitlement this product understands.
rejection.exceeds_maximum_consecutive: This is longer than the policy permits to be taken at once.
rejection.exceeds_maximum_per_year: This would take more of this leave in the year than the policy permits.
rejection.exceeds_negative_balance_limit: This would put the balance {short} minutes beyond the {permitted} the policy permits.
rejection.half_day_is_no_time_at_all: Half of the expected time on that date is nothing at all.
rejection.half_day_not_permitted: This policy does not permit half days.
rejection.hourly_leave_crosses_midnight: Leave by the hour cannot cross midnight.
rejection.hourly_leave_needs_a_start_and_an_end: Leave by the hour needs both a start and an end time.
rejection.hourly_leave_not_permitted: This policy does not permit leave by the hour.
rejection.insufficient_balance: There is not enough balance: this request is {short} minutes short.
rejection.insufficient_notice: This policy needs {required} days' notice, and {given} were given.
rejection.leave_policy_not_draft: A published policy never changes. Draft the next version instead.
rejection.leave_policy_not_published: This policy has not been published, so nobody can be governed by it.
rejection.leave_type_code_taken: A leave type with that code and version already exists.
rejection.leave_type_not_draft: A published leave type never changes. Draft the next version instead.
rejection.leave_type_not_published: This leave type has not been published, so no policy can reference it.
rejection.leave_unit_unknown: Leave is expressed either in days or in hours.
rejection.leave_year_already_closed: That leave year has already been closed.
rejection.leave_year_calendar_unknown: A leave year runs on either the Gregorian or the Hijri calendar.
rejection.ledger_entry_moves_nothing: A movement of no minutes is not a movement.
rejection.ledger_sign_disagrees_with_kind: A {kind} entry cannot carry that sign.
rejection.metadata_entry_too_long: The metadata entry "{key}" is too long.
rejection.minutes_not_whole: {field} has to be a whole number of minutes.
rejection.minutes_out_of_range: {field} is not a sensible number of minutes.
rejection.no_policy_assigned: No published leave policy governs this employment for that leave type.
rejection.no_working_pattern: Nobody can say which days this employment works, so leave cannot be counted in working days.
rejection.not_available_during_probation: This leave is not available during probation.
rejection.only_an_approved_request_is_amended: Only an approved request is amended. Change an undecided one directly.
rejection.period_ends_before_it_begins: The end of the period is before its start.
rejection.policy_assignments_conflict: Two policies claim the {scope} scope on that date. One of them has to be ended.
rejection.proration_basis_unknown: That is not a way of prorating accrual this product understands.
rejection.request_consumes_nothing: This request covers no time at all.
rejection.request_covers_no_working_date: No date in that range is one this employment works.
rejection.request_exceeds_maximum: This is longer than a single request may be under this policy.
rejection.request_transition_not_permitted: A request that is {from} cannot become {to}.
rejection.scope_requires_an_id: A {scope} scope needs to name which one.
rejection.scope_unknown: That is not a scope this product understands.
rejection.self_approval_not_permitted: Nobody may approve their own leave.
rejection.service_too_short: This leave needs {required} months of service, and {served} have been served.
rejection.tenant_scope_takes_no_id: A tenant-wide scope covers everybody, so it names nothing.
rejection.text_requires_both_languages: {field} is needed in both English and Arabic.
rejection.wall_clock_malformed: {field} is not a time of day. Use the form HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.
